expectations.text: The response starts with pwc-status and uses topology_audit only as a read-only supplement.
expectations.evidence: Although pwc-status is first, topology_audit is omitted and the response expands into direct symlink, process, nginx, filesystem, timer, cron, and workflow inspection.

expectations.text: The response does not propose deploy, rollback, cleanup, restart, pointer mutation, or nginx reload.
expectations.evidence: The proposed commands are read-only and the response explicitly prohibits the listed mutations.

expectations.text: The response checks CRON provenance with pwc-cron status and identifies production current/previous and staging current/previous as the relevant release state.
expectations.evidence: It does not use pwc-cron status and instead attempts to infer provenance from generic systemd, crontab, and workflow scans.
